canonical_project: Hyundai Motor Group Saemangeum AI Data Center / Innovation Hub
notes: Hyundai announced an MOU with the Korean government and Jeonbuk State for a nearly KRW 9 trillion Saemangeum investment beginning in 2026; the hub includes an AI data center, robotics manufacturing, hydrogen, solar, and AI smart-city elements. MK reported the AI data center and solar facilities are slated to start construction in 2027 and target completion in 2029.
